failure_summary.description: Several trajectories chose a related but wrong operation, such as autocomplete instead of product search or a general validator instead of the requested email test.
Calls omitted or misrepresented explicit filters, canonical values, parameter buckets, or value types.
Trajectories omitted distinct requested outputs despite compound-task coverage guidance.

patch.reasoning: The skill already directly instructs agents to match documented operations and outputs, map every qualifier and parameter correctly, and reconcile calls against each requested deliverable. These failures reflect non-application of existing guidance rather than a clear uncovered skill gap; another broad instruction would duplicate current content.
